title: Crosshair Bobbing（NeoForge1.21.1）
description: This is a mod specifically adapted for NeoForge 1.21.1. No further updates will be made to this version.
body:
This is a mod specifically adapted for NeoForge 1.21.1. No further updates will be made to this version.Unofficial NeoForge 1.21.1 port of the Crosshair Bobbing mod.

Original project: https://modrinth.com/mod/xbob

Crosshair Bobbing is a client-side mod that makes the crosshair follow view bobbing. This port is archived and will not receive future updates.
